title: Serapeum granite boxes found blown apart

tellings.quote: these Chambers are mysterious but what is interesting about them is that many of them were found blown up like exploded like a lot of energy had surged through and blown them up

plain: The Serapeum, an underground tomb complex at Saqqara in Egypt full of huge granite boxes, is said to hold many boxes that were found "blown up," as if "a lot of energy had surged through" them. The researcher Matt LaCroix tells this without naming a source. He suggests it points to some powerful force or lost technology in the ancient past.
